privacy:
This Privacy Policy explains how {{OWNER}} ("PlotCloud", "we") collects, uses and protects personal information when you use PlotCloud. We follow Canada's Personal Information Protection and Electronic Documents Act (PIPEDA) and British Columbia's Personal Information Protection Act.

## What we collect
- Account details: your email address, display name, school and program, and your password (stored only as a secure hash by our login provider).
- Membership and payment records: your plan, dates and amounts. Card details go directly to our payment provider (Stripe) and are never stored by us.
- Activity: which resources you download and when, the sets you save, and your requests and votes.
- Technical information: your IP address, kept as a one-way hash for abuse prevention, plus basic browser and device information.
- Messages you send us, for example support requests.

## What we don't collect
- Files you open in our browser tools stay on your device and are not uploaded, unless a tool clearly says otherwise.
- We do not use advertising trackers, and we do not sell or rent personal information.

## Why we use it
- To run your account, deliver downloads and enforce download limits.
- To process payments and keep the financial records the law requires.
- To prevent fraud, account sharing and abuse.
- To answer support requests.
- To send service emails, such as receipts, renewal notices and important changes.
- To send news and offers only if you opt in. You can unsubscribe from any such email at any time, as required by Canada's Anti-Spam Legislation (CASL).

## Cookies and analytics
We use only the cookies needed to keep you logged in and the Service secure. We measure site traffic with Cloudflare Web Analytics, which does not use cookies or track you across sites.

## Who we share it with
We share personal information only with service providers that help us run PlotCloud, under contracts that require them to protect it:
- Supabase (accounts and database)
- Cloudflare (file storage, security and analytics)
- Stripe (payments)
- Our email delivery provider (receipts and account emails)
- Our website host
We may also disclose information when the law requires it.

## Where it is stored
Some of these providers store or process data outside Canada, including in the United States. Information stored outside Canada is subject to the laws of that country and may be accessed by its authorities.

## How long we keep it
We keep account information while your account is open. When you close your account, we delete or anonymise your personal information within 90 days, except payment and tax records, which we keep for 6 years as Canadian tax law requires.

## Your rights
You can ask to see the personal information we hold about you, ask us to correct it, withdraw consent for optional uses, or ask us to delete your account. Email {{EMAIL}} and we will reply within 30 days. If you are not satisfied with our answer, you can complain to the Office of the Privacy Commissioner of Canada or the Office of the Information and Privacy Commissioner for British Columbia.

## Security
We use encryption in transit, access controls and limited staff access to protect your information. If a breach creates a real risk of significant harm, we will notify you and the Privacy Commissioner as the law requires.

## Age
PlotCloud is meant for people aged 16 and over. We do not knowingly collect information from children under 13.

## Changes
We will post any changes here with a new date, and email members about significant changes.

## Contact our privacy officer
